working_on.feature: System-wide Vietnamese Exception Localization & Structured Cause/Action Guidance
working_on.notes: All error and exception messages across the system now have structured Vietnamese guidance ('Nguyên nhân:' and 'Cách xử lý:'). Japanese NFKC normalization restored for department matching. Sales account inheritance logic verified. Full test suite: 156 passed, 6 skipped.

completed_milestones: Phase 14: Localized all account_resolver, fixed_assets, loader, and source_order_writer exceptions to Vietnamese.

Phase 15: Fixed sales account inheritance bug on multi-line allocation rules in loader.py; localized schema migration failures with structured cause/action without leaking raw English database driver errors.
Phase 16: Localized all ContentPackError, headcount_time_plan parse errors, and fiscal_periods SystemSourcePeriodError exceptions with structured 'Nguyên nhân:' and 'Cách xử lý:'.

Phase 17: Restored NFKC Unicode normalization in headcount_time_plan.py for full-width/half-width Japanese character/digit matching; added conditional skip for physical data fixture tests in test_headcount_time_source.py.
Phase 18: Completed structured cause/action guidance for all 4 safe_extract_zip exception branches in update_security.py and added branch-level tests.

decisions_made.decision: All user-facing exceptions must include structured cause and action guidance
decisions_made.reason: Users must know exactly what went wrong and what step-by-step action to take. Raw English technical driver/OS errors must be logged into debug logs, not shown in user-facing dialogs.

decisions_made.decision: Apply NFKC Unicode normalization before matching department names and CC codes
decisions_made.reason: Japanese Excel forms freely mix full-width (Zen-kaku) and half-width (Han-kaku) characters (e.g. ＡＢＣ製造課 vs ABC製造課, １４１２００００４０ vs 1412000040).

decisions_made.decision: Sales account inheritance on continuation rows must match manufacturing and general accounts
decisions_made.reason: Blank sales_acc cells on continuation rows belong to the same expense item and must inherit the current item's sales account.

decisions_made.decision: Tests requiring external physical sample folders must use conditional skipUnless
decisions_made.reason: Allows clean execution in CI/CD and sandbox environments while preserving real fixture coverage on developer machines.
